text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was brainstorming ways to 
polish our concept 
by giving the Demon Realm Cafe a 
story-like setting.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The customers are "newbie demons," and the 
two of us are "high-ranking demons." 
In that case... let's come up with a role 
for Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Right! To craft the best possible plan... 
First, we should scout out the 
competition.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The President's group is running a 
theatrical cafe, but... 
I see, their presence is truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Their acting is magnificent too. The fans 
will definitely be drawn into that 
world... 
——! Oh no, they've spotted us! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...... 
—Hmph, so they're finally making a move...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Currently, Sis Groove's costume is a dress 
with a design similar to ours, 
but... we should refine it a bit more, 
shouldn't we?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Air Groove wants to assign roles to 
us staff and visiting fans 
to make the cafe experience truly 
immersive.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Our role is that of "high-ranking demons" 
welcoming fans into the demon realm... but 
having Air Groove in the exact same role 
feels underwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Then let's think of a role truly worthy of 
Sis Groove. 
And alongside that, reconsider her costume 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Sis Groove is someone who guides us. 
Why don't we incorporate that directly 
into her role?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A sovereign ruling over all demons, 
perhaps...? 
Both us high-ranking demons and the fans 
would become Sis Groove's kin and vassals.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful. The narrative will 
be inviting fans into our cafe——the Demon 
King's castle——to expand her dominion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
So the character image for Sis Groove as 
the sovereign would be...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Possessing overwhelming dignity and 
charisma, 
yet filled with love to protect and guide 
her kin...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The "Empress" ruling over the Demon 
Realm... A motherly figure to all demons——

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's settled. 
Let's head back to the shop tomorrow to 
discuss the modifications.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If we want to give this wine red and black 
dress 
a true "Empress" feel...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
How about adding generous gold ornaments? 
I believe it'll give off a more 
prestigious, dignified impression.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that sounds splendid——Ah. 
Senpai, what about that accessory...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That heart one? ...Good idea. 
After all, "deep down, she holds great 
love for her kin."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ......With this, it's complete.

text_block_list.name: Alve & Dura
text_block_list.text: ——"The Demon Empress."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The proposal and costume are both flawless 
now. 
Let's hurry and show Sis Groove——

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait. 
...Air Groove is dozing off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Could you hand that to me? ...I'll leave 
it beside her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
——Gah! Not good, not good... Ah, time to 
handle the delivery. 
I need to wrap up the proposal today too, 
or... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ——"Regarding the Project Revision"...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As a refinement proposal for the booth, 
we have designed a role fitting for you, 
along with modifications to your costume."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Your role is the 'Demon Empress' who 
rules over all demons. 
...We believe this role suits you best."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To us, Sis Groove is dependable, strict 
yet warm, and deeply 
respectable—a magnificent figure we could 
only look up to."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"However... through preparing this booth, 
we learned just how hard you 
strive every day, sometimes struggling, 
always aiming for greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"In homage to that journey—and to the way 
you carry yourself— 
we would like to present you with the role 
and outfit of the 'Demon Empress.'"

text_block_list.name: Alve & Dura
text_block_list.text:
"——With this, please captivate every 
single fan."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
——...Heh, haha... When did those girls put 
together a plan like this...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Me, as the "Demon Empress," huh...? 
And the dress... they've arranged it into 
something quite magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I truly am blessed... Surrounded by such 
hardworking, brilliant, and 
proud girls... and to have them place such 
faith in me——)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
——Then I have no choice but to answer 
their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
With everything I have... no, even if it 
means surpassing my limits. 
As the ultimate "Demon Empress," I will 
seize victory without fail!
